Advanced test controls

Freeze: pull in your elbows during the 1.5 s yellow, hold through the 2.5 s red; success +100, failure −12. Mosquito: select a wrist, then drag fast onto the mosquito or clap on it; +50 within 10 s, −5 on timeout. Lava: raise the hip within 8 s to stay above the surface; burns cost 5 HP per second, a clean finish +75. These are synthetic coordinate controls.
